chose: The Game Week essay is a genre of its own, `game-essay`, by the genres' rules (C410, C1026): one hue, a deep crimson (#c42b3f) on a near-black wine ground (#1d0e14), apart from the six taken (its nearest, the report's coral, is 35 apart in CIELAB, 22 under simulated deuteranopia, wider than the closest pair before it) and from sky and leaf, which the status dots use; and one shape drawn only in paths and rects, a gridiron from end zone to end zone with its line of scrimmage lit and the line to gain beside it, beside a waveform as every essay that holds the owner's voice has. Its thumbnail is titled "Week <n>: <first game>" ("Week 48: NE at CHI") and named "Game Week".
options: A deep crimson, and a gridiron beside a voice's waveform (chosen): a red no genre has, dark enough to stay apart from the report's coral for colour-blind eyes, and the one image the essay draws, a still of the field at a moment.
Teal: between sky and leaf, so a colour-blind eye can take it for a status dot.
Turf green, the field's own colour: leaf, which C410 keeps for the dots.
A football: a team's ball reads as sport but says nothing of the essay, and is near a logo.
gray: A genre's colour and shape are what the owner sees on every thumbnail and in Studio's row; no decision gives this one's, and the owner may move it.
undo: Change `game-essay`'s entry in GENRE_PAINT, or its `game` shape, in packages/some-styles/src/brand/genres.ts; its title in packages/video-render/src/thumbnail.ts.
